_comment: Lines shown to everyone else when a player enters / leaves the world. A random one is picked per event (the same line for every viewer). Placeholders: {name} = character name, {level} = level as an ordinal (10th), {class} = class in lowercase (voidknight). Add or edit lines freely — each list just needs at least one entry.
join: {name}, the {level} season {class}, has returned to Aldenexia!
The winds stir... {name}, the {level} season {class}, walks the world once more.
{name}, the {level} season {class}, steps into the light of Aldenexia!
Word spreads through Lumora: {name}, the {level} season {class}, has arrived.
{name}, the {level} season {class}, answers the call of Aldenexia!
A new footfall echoes across the land... {name}, the {level} season {class}.
leave: {name}, the {level} season {class}, fades from the world...
The road calls {name}, the {level} season {class}, away from Aldenexia.
{name}, the {level} season {class}, slips into the mists and is gone.
